403.description: Current project permission/visibility refused, including missing/wrong-project targets; no body/snapshot/current A mutationOutcome with the exact request operationId, status not_applied and phase pre_dispatch certifies this HTTP attempt was rejected before dispatch, with no stored operation observed. A client may resume corrected creation only after atomically retiring a single-attempt journal; another overlapping attempt may still commit. Bare 403 or a result-lookup failure does not establish nonapplication.
